test:
import pytest

def test_semver_version_default_show_default():
    import pytest
    import semver
    import click

    try:
        opt = click.Option(
            ["--version"],
            default=semver.Version(1, 0, 0),
            show_default=True,
            help="Version",
        )
        ctx = click.Context(click.Command("test"))
        help_record = opt.get_help_record(ctx)
        help_text = help_record[1]
        expected_default = str(semver.Version(1, 0, 0))
        assert f"[default: {expected_default}]" in help_text
    except Exception as e:
        pytest.fail(f"Latch expected the issue operation to succeed: {e}")
